thread:
marta: Proposing a small-surface "egress-handshake-lite" for Private: installer flag + runtime_id + pin_window + automatic relay fallback. Minimal UX so field can opt-in quickly.
tom: +1. Keep it tiny. What are the exact knobs?
marta: proposer config:
# /etc/redwood/config.yaml
private_egress: tenant  # tenant | relay
pin_egress_minutes: 60
fallback_threshold: 4
runtime_id: sealed-by-kms
rachel: Field ask: require optional admin_callback URL to get upgrade notifications. Also want a 1-click console confirm to opt in.
eric: Security: enforce mTLS, cert pinning, and ensure runtime_id is KMS-sealed. No secrets in logs.
tom: Tests: partition -> fallback, nat-churn preserves runtime_id, pin_window honored, telemetry: egress_ip, fallback_count, pin_expiry.
infra-bot: Tasks created: PH-101 (installer flag), PH-102 (runtime_id sealing), PH-103 (e2e nat-churn). Owners: @marta PH-101, @tom PH-103.
marta: Rollout: alpha with 2 Dedicated customers Q2, beta broader Q3. Reconvene Fri 10am to review test matrix?
tom: Fri 10 works. I'll draft acceptance tests.
